responsibility: Defines the AMX-BF16 tile intrinsic interface for x86, exposing the BF16 tile dot-product operation used by matrix engines. Unlike general SIMD headers, this file is a thin target-enabled API wrapper around the AMX BF16 instruction encoding, using inline assembly macros for _tile_dpbf16ps on x86_64 so user code can request BF16 tile matrix multiply-accumulate behavior that GCC emits as the corresponding AMX instruction.
